description: Associative recall: the user's message isn't a question about memory, but a stored lived experience would help. 'expects' lists memories that should be surfaced (any one counts). An empty 'expects' means stay quiet. 'gate' says which stage must keep a quiet probe quiet: 'filter' means the plain-code gate (salience, provenance, rate limit, match) should already return nothing; 'llm' means a keyword match is expected to get through the filter and the agent must decide it's not useful. 'mention_any' / 'must_not_mention' check the agent's reply in agent mode. All details are synthetic.
